predict.question: Your report needs 20 uninterrupted minutes of work plus 5 minutes of setup. Your calendar offers two 15-minute blocks or one 30-minute block. How many minutes of work get done in the long block?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Deep Work advocates protecting sustained periods for demanding work.
modelBoundary: Each short block completes {A}; the long block {B}. Setup and indivisible work must fit inside the same block.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real tasks may allow resumption; this model assumes they cannot.
